captions.caption: A person in a brown jacket opens a white door, letting a black and white dog run outside.
The camera follows the dog running out of a doorway, pointing up towards a bright, overcast sky.
The dog stands in a snowy yard, looking around at its surroundings.
The dog shakes its head and begins to run through the deep snow.
The dog runs away from the camera, following a path up a snowy incline.
The dog continues running up the snowy path, leaving footprints behind.
A view of a snowy farmyard with a blue ATV parked next to a garage and silos in the background.
The camera pans right, showing the snowy landscape with farm buildings and trees at sunrise.
The camera continues to pan right across the snow-covered yard and driveway.
The camera pans from the snowy yard towards the blue ATV parked next to the garage.
A close-up view of the back and side of the blue Polaris Sportsman ATV.
A closer view of the blue ATV's seat and front windshield.
A man wearing a black beanie and a brown jacket stands in the snow, talking to the camera.
The man continues talking to the camera with a snowy farm landscape in the background.
The man explains what the weather conditions were like on the previous day.
He continues to speak to the camera, describing the extremely cold temperatures.
The man continues his explanation about the weather, looking directly at the camera.
The man adjusts his beanie while talking about the cold weather from the day before.
He continues to describe the cold, mentioning the windchill was in the mid-20s below zero.
The man gestures with his hand as he explains there was no way he would take the tractor out.
He continues talking, explaining that nothing would start in the extreme cold.
The man points over his shoulder towards the garage while talking about the ATV not starting.
He walks forward while talking, moving past the green garage doors.
He continues walking and explaining that the four-wheeler wouldn't start yesterday morning.
The man walks back towards his original spot, still talking to the camera.
He explains that the tractor would start because it was parked inside the heated shop.
He talks about the risks of taking machinery out in such extreme cold.
The man explains the potential for problems if the tractor were to break down outside.
He describes the danger of the windchill being over 20 below zero.
He gravely states that those are the conditions in which people can die.
The man shakes his head, emphasizing that he was not going to take that risk yesterday.
He adds that on top of the cold, he and his family had to leave town anyway.
He explains they had to go to a hockey game for his son.
He then describes his plans for the current day, which involve a trip to Minneapolis.
The man says he is going to watch the Minnesota Vikings play the Chicago Bears.
He continues talking about the football game he and his son are attending.
He mentions that they got nosebleed seats for the game.
The man expresses hope that it won't be the last game of the year for the Vikings.
He explains that if the Vikings can beat Chicago, they will make the playoffs.
A text overlay appears that reads, "Yeah, Bears Fans, I Know," as he speaks.
With the text on screen, he acknowledges that Chicago has a good team.
He expresses confidence that if the Vikings play well, they can beat the Bears.
The man continues to talk about the importance of the football game, gesturing with his hand.
He describes the game as a do-or-die situation for the Vikings' season.
He concludes by saying that it's going to be a lot of fun regardless of the outcome.
The man explains that before they leave, he needs to clear the driveway of snow.
He says he's going to use the four-wheeler with the plow to clear the snow.
He looks over his shoulder at the blue ATV parked by the garage.
The man begins walking towards the blue ATV.
He continues walking across the snowy driveway towards the ATV.
The camera follows him as he approaches the vehicle.
A close-up view of the ATV's handlebars, dashboard, and ignition.
The man's gloved hand reaches for the key in the ATV's ignition.
He turns the key in the ignition, and the ATV's digital display lights up.
The ATV engine turns over and starts, and the man prepares to drive.
The camera view shows the man's perspective as he sits on the running ATV.
The man puts the ATV in gear, preparing to move.
He begins to drive the ATV forward out of its parking spot.
The ATV moves forward, showing the snow-covered ground in front of it.
The man drives the ATV across the snowy driveway.
